section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section details a correlation analysis and a mediating effect test. It establishes negative correlations between perceived social support and loneliness, and psychological capital and loneliness, while perceived social support and psychological capital are positively correlated. The analysis, conducted in three steps, confirms that psychological capital plays a partial mediating role in the relationship between adolescents' social support and loneliness, with all test results being statistically significant.
